## sub_58850F_0058850f — StringToDoubleWithLocale

**Summary:** Skips leading whitespace from a string and then parses the remainder as a double value using locale-aware encoding detection, returning the parsed double.

**Frame-path:** ON_FRAME_PATH  
**Call frequency:** per-frame tick

**Called by:** RaceCommentaryDirectorSystem (0040d4c0), ConfigIniParser (00421cd0), sub_424080 (00424080), TrackConfig (0042e530), sub_493990 (00493990), sub_4BE760 (004be760), sub_4BF6A0 (004bf6a0), sub_4C02D0 (004c02d0), PlayerCareerStatsGameOptionsLoader (004c18b0), GameOptionsWriter (004c1e80), sub_4CDC70 (004cdc70), SpecialFX_Init (004cf070), Steward_Restart (004d3cf0), WeatherNameWetnessMultiplier (004fe0d0), WeatherSeverityGripMultiplier (004fe1e0), sub_4FE2B0 (004fe2b0), sub_4FE350 (004fe350), AudioMixerSampleGetWithFallback (00564580)
